name: AwardWings
description:
Your EuroBonus points deserve a trip, not another evening searching.

Tell Claude where you want to go, your dates, and how many people are traveling. AwardWings searches SAS and SkyTeam partner awards through EuroBonus, helping you compare cabins, points prices, seat counts, connections, and taxes where available in one conversation.

See when results were checked, revisit saved trips and recent searches, review your award alerts, and compare the value of using points against a cash fare you provide. Planning a harder-to-find route? Ask for Nordic feeder-airport suggestions or round trips paired from your checked partner results.

AwardWings distinguishes a completed search with no seats from a search that could not finish. Availability can change; confirm and book directly with SAS.

Start free, with no card required: five one-time introductory connector searches plus two daily SAS searches shared with the website. Plus unlocks unlimited SAS searches. Pro adds SkyTeam and personal planning tools. Plus and Pro include a 1-day trial. Search in English, Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish, and ask Claude to explain the results in your preferred language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AwardWings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AwardWings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://awardwings.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AwardWings MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AwardWings provides these MCP tools: calculate_point_value, find_ready_made_trips, list_alerts, list_recent_searches, list_saved_trips, search_sas_awards, search_skyteam_awards, and suggest_feeders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AwardWings?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AwardWings in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
AwardWings requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AwardWings is developed by AwardWings. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
